analysis: Cross-source read: the overnight move is almost entirely rates, not company news. The 10Y inched ~2 bps higher this morning to ~5.13-5.14% (a near-20-year high; 30Y at its 2004 high), CME Oct-hike odds held ~71%, and futures stayed red — the same yield-and-geopolitics tape as the 4am brief, just priced slightly heavier. New since the 4am brief: (1) Meta Connect selloff details — a $1,299 VR glasses reveal, 'Muse Charm' pocket AI device, retail integrations, and a CPO Cox 40k-share sale disclosure (~$28.5M, single-source); (2) chip stocks broadly extending premarket losses with the 10Y at 5.12% (AMD ~-2%, INTC -3%+), keeping NVDA's insider-sale overhang in a weak tape; (3) Tesla's Grok rollout to AMD-chip cars as a small AI-optionality offset to the FSD-probe/delivery-cut overhang; (4) Cook and Musk confirmed at the Trump-Xi meeting today — the summit is the day's genuine swing factor with the tariff truce now extended to Jan 10, 2027. Signal vs noise: the AMZN $3B India figure remains single-source and unconfirmed; the Generac +33% premarket Amazon-deal headline is single-source with an unconfirmed date — treat both as fragile. HN/Reddit sweeps found nothing qualifying again. Earnings-adjacent watch: Costco reports after the close.
disclaimer: Not financial advice — for informational purposes only.

headlines.headline: S&P 500 E-minis fell ~0.6% (-44.25 pts) premarket; Dow E-minis -0.33% (-173 pts); Nasdaq-100 E-minis -1.01% (-309.75 pts).
headlines.why_it_matters: Futures stayed red overnight — the yield spike is compressing equity multiples heading into the open.

headlines.headline: 10Y Treasury yield ~5.13-5.14%, up ~2 bps this morning and near a 20-year high; closed Wednesday at the highest since July 2007. 30Y hit 5.44%, highest since 2004; 5Y crossed 5% for the first time in nearly two decades; 2Y at 4.93%. CME FedWatch shows ~71% odds of a 25bp October hike; NY Fed's John Williams said another hike this year is a 'reasonable' expectation.
headlines.why_it_matters: The entire curve repricing higher is the macro variable squeezing growth multiples — the ~71% October-hike odds are what's being watched into the open.

headlines.headline: Brent crude +1.7% at ~$104.80/bbl and WTI +1.3% at ~$93.35/bbl as the US-Iran conflict shows no sign of resolution.
headlines.why_it_matters: Higher energy costs feed inflation expectations, pulling forward rate-hike bets — a second leg of pressure on yields.

headlines.headline: Day 1 of the Trump-Xi White House summit: trade truce extended to Jan 10, 2027 (Bessent, after talks with Vice Premier He Lifeng); Xi arrived Wednesday evening, greeted by Trump at Andrews AFB. Agenda: AI governance, rare earths, tariffs, fentanyl, Taiwan arms sales. State dinner tonight with tech CEOs including Tim Cook, Jensen Huang, Elon Musk, Sundar Pichai, Jeff Bezos, and Sam Altman.
headlines.why_it_matters: The summit is today's swing factor — AI regulation, tariff terms, rare earths, and Taiwan headlines can move tech and trade-exposed names intraday.

headlines.headline: Meta fell ~2.5% premarket ($725.25 vs $744.10 close) the morning after Meta Connect, where it unveiled $1,299 VR glasses (100g), a pocket-sized 'Muse Charm' AI device, and retail integrations (Walmart, Best Buy, Sephora). CPO Christopher Cox disclosed selling 40,000 shares (~$28.5M) — single-source, unconfirmed beyond one outlet.
headlines.why_it_matters: Classic sell-the-news after a 10-12% weekly run-up; the CPO insider sale (single-source, unconfirmed — treat as fragile) can amplify the selloff narrative, and hardware/Muse spending re-raises capex questions.

headlines.headline: NVDA trading lower premarket alongside AMD (~-2%) and INTC (-3%+) as the 10Y hit 5.12%; TD Cowen kept a Hold on Intel with a $115 price target. TipRanks report; the yield/oil moves are corroborated by other outlets.
headlines.why_it_matters: Rate-driven multiple compression hitting the AI trade broadly, independent of any new NVDA-specific catalyst — keeps the Stevens insider-sale overhang in a weak tape.

headlines.headline: Tesla added Grok AI to AMD-chip cars (software 2025.26+, via Wi-Fi or Premium Connectivity); August EU registrations came in at 15,430 (+4% YoY). Stock +0.45% premarket at $380.62; Elon Musk is invited to Trump's White House meeting with Xi today.
headlines.why_it_matters: A small AI-optionality lift against the FSD-probe and Q3 delivery-cut overhang; the Xi-meeting invite adds a trade-policy angle to the name today.

headlines.headline: Tim Cook is invited to Trump's meeting with China's Xi in Washington today; no fresh Apple-specific news otherwise.
headlines.why_it_matters: Direct read-through to iPhone supply chain and tariff risk — the overhang behind the iPhone-18 price-hike news — with the truce extension as modest relief.

headlines.headline: Generac reportedly +33% premarket on a $2.4B long-term Amazon data-center generator deal (deliveries 2027-28, up to $8B total, Amazon granted a warrant) — the report's date could not be confirmed, so treat as carry rather than fresh. No fresh Amazon-specific news; the $3B India commitment remains single-source and unconfirmed.
headlines.why_it_matters: Reads through to Amazon's AI-infra buildout scale — but single-source with an unconfirmed date, so treat the deal figures as fragile.
